explication: MoGe estimates monocular 3D geometry from images, returning point, depth, and normal maps and camera FOV. The main user workflow is to load a pretrained model and run inference; CLI, panorama, and interactive-app interfaces provide additional ways to use it. The repository also includes data preparation, losses, and training/checkpoint workflows. Edges are limited to relationships stated in the README or shown by the supplied source excerpts and SOURCE INDEX; some interface and internal details are unsampled.
